main_text.head: EPIGRAMMA DE SVBSCRIPTO ABHISPANORVM CLASSE IDOLO Christi Symbolo, ex Psal. 73. Exurge Iehoua, iudica causam tuam: fatalium internecione coelitus comprobato Anno Domini 1588.
main_text.p:
ÆRata Hispanus Neptunum classe secabat,
Excidio veniens Nympha Britanna tibi.
Quum subito horribiles euertunt aquora venti,
Mergitur & tumidis naufraga puppis aquis.
Quid fit? suspensum malo sub imagine Christum
Furtuo hoc tituli Carmine sollicitant:
SVRGE, TVAE QVAE PATROCINIVM NE DESERE CAVSAE,

SVRGE: Sed est surda ligneus aure Deus.
Stulte quid imploras fabrefactum numen Ibere?
An feret auxilium qui indiget auxilio?
Ista est irati, qui ventis laxat habenas
Causa Dei: Causam nunc agit ille suam,

page.notes: The page is a verse epigram with a Latin title and scripture reference, and the scan is in the italic/roman mix of the period. Reading of the verse lines is provisional: "Furtuo" and "sollicitant" and the lines "Ista est irati" and "Causa Dei" are doubtful, and the last word "Ille" stands alone at the lower right, set apart from the stanza. The final line of the poem is cut off at the bottom of the scan.
